VBO:0200574.summary: German pointers include the Shorthaired, Wirehaired, Longhaired and Roughhaired breeds, each with its own standard. These continental gundogs belong to a pointing tradition; the Shorthaired standard also describes development into a versatile hunting dog.
VBO:0200574.shortDescription: German Shorthaired, Wirehaired, Longhaired and Roughhaired Pointers are distinct continental gundog breeds.
